Signs You Need Septic Service

If your system is showing warning signs, it may be time to book septic service in Chilliwack before a small issue turns into a bigger repair. A professional inspection can help identify the cause, protect your property, and keep your septic system working the way it should.

– Slow drains or gurgling pipes
– Sewage odors inside or outside
– Wet spots or pooling water near the tank or drainfield
– Toilets backing up
– Unusually lush grass around the septic area
– It’s been several years since your last pump-out

How Often Should You Schedule Septic Tank Pumping in Chilliwack?

There is no one-size-fits-all pumping schedule for every property. The timing depends on factors like tank capacity, household size, water use, and the age of the system. For many homes and properties in Chilliwack, scheduling septic tank pumping every 3 to 5 years is a solid general guideline, but more frequent service may be needed for larger households, farms, or heavy-use systems.
